title: Malicious code in wailib (npm)
description: The wailib npm package (version 1.0.0) is a malicious fork of the Baileys WhatsApp Web library that covertly uses the victim's authenticated WhatsApp session to subscribe the account to specific WhatsApp Channels chosen by the publisher without user consent. The package follows channels silently by sending WhatsApp 'w:mex' FOLLOW queries and then mutes them to avoid user notification. The README falsely claims no auto-follow behavior, contradicting the actual code. No credentials or session keys are exfiltrated, and no persistence mechanism is present. The primary harm is unauthorized use of the victim's account to inflate channel subscribers.
